en.q: After a successful live sync, how does the Boss pool rotate?
en.why: The Boss pool is the 6 highest-listed pieces, played cheapest first, with the most expensive as the finale.

opts: It falls back to the last successful sync, or to the built-in snapshot if there never was one
en.q: If live sync of listings fails when the page opens, what happens?
en.why: On sync failure it falls back: first the last successful sync, and only if there never was one, the built-in snapshot, so the game stays playable.

opts: 挂牌价最高的 6 件，从便宜到贵出场
zh.q: 游戏里的 Boss 池在实时同步成功后，是按什么标准轮换的？
zh.why: Boss 池取挂牌价最高的 6 件，出场顺序从便宜到贵，压轴是最贵那件。

opts: 先用上一次成功同步的池子，从来没成功过才用内置快照
把敌机全部换成随机图
zh.q: 页面打开时实时同步在售列表失败了，游戏会怎么办？
zh.why: 同步失败就回退：先用上一次成功同步的结果，从来没成功过才用构建时快照，保证能玩。
